payload.text: Each item needs hv, and each is released as hv does it. (1) Contacts, from iTerm, before the next reboot. iTerm declares its use of Contacts, so macOS can prompt for it; Herdr.app and Terminal.app declare none, so macOS refuses them without a prompt. First the live parity's five sync rows: zsh /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-matts-Devel-prj-Pplr/f3516df3-3c28-4ed2-820f-b9b34ea2e5f8/scratchpad/parity/hv-next.zsh contacts (cc's HV-ROWS.md: allow the prompt, then paste back what it prints), for AC-00.5, whose email rows already match (728465f). Then the live Contacts test, cargo test --test cli live -- --ignored, in a cargo slot from vc (ST0001 AC-09.2). (2) Create the geodica.apple.{APPLE_ID,APPLE_APP_PASSWORD,APPLE_TEAM_ID} keychain entries. (3) Allow Developer ID signing, the identity check and the first notarytool submission (ST0002 WP07, AC-07.1 and 07.2). (4) Intent fixes outside pplr: the pre-commit hook's word-splitting, AGENTS.md's swift lines, and the estate page's false orphaned holds (watchouts 1 to 3). (6) ST0002 WP05: the real brew install from a scratch tap; dc prepares everything up to it (it could shadow ~/.local/bin/pplr). (7) ST0002 WP04. The tap's description and CI need gh repo edit and a tap push (AC-04.2). For AC-04.1, dc measured the render clean, but brew style refuses the manifest header devbin generates (131 columns against brew's 118, lib/cmd/formula:424); Homebrew forbids the RuboCop wrap, and one element per line passes, so file the Devbin issue dc wrote (banked on the local branch dc/devbin-issue at 84972b4, as devbin-issue-formula-manifest; never pushed, never merged). brew audit --strict, run under the trust hv granted in dc's session and undone at once, has that same line as its one problem, so the issue's fix clears both. Each push is hv's, from the terminal: the auto-mode classifier refuses one from vc's session.
